Radon Testing: Missouri has significant radon levels, especially in the Ozarks Missouri has elevated radon throughout the state. Reddit strongly recommends testing before finishing basements. The granite in the Ozarks produces particularly high levels.

Foundation & Clay Soil Issues: Missouri Expansive clay is common throughout Missouri, especially in the St. Louis area. Reddit recommends proper drainage management and structural engineer consultation for foundation work.

Basement Moisture: Missouri basements commonly have moisture issues Wet basements are very common. Reddit recommends addressing exterior grading and drainage first, then interior waterproofing systems with sump pumps.

St. Louis Brick & Tuckpointing: St. Louis has extensive brick homes requiring regular maintenance St. Louis brick homes need tuckpointing every 25-30 years. Reddit emphasizes using correct mortar type—modern mortar is too hard for historic brick. Poor tuckpointing causes more damage.
